paul: SDK nit: docs use `reserve()` but library exposes `create_reservation(...)`. also wrap in try/except. sample:
```python
from redwood.dedicated import DedicatedClient, AuthenticationError
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
try:
    r = client.create_reservation(token='rsv-42', region='us-west-2')
    print(r.id)
except AuthenticationError:
    print('auth failed')
```
